subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the indexed transcript write-lock runner and its three persistence-fact reads as public Plugin SDK API, or keep this optimization behind a non-public bundled-owner boundary?
rationale: The change adds a documented, baselined Plugin SDK surface beyond the parent transcript-read work; choosing the long-term external contract cannot be resolved mechanically from tests or benchmarks.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow public contract
options.body: Approve the indexed lock as a stable generic SDK capability, with its semantics and compatibility expectations kept explicit.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Rework the optimization so Codex and Copilot use an owner-scoped or bundled-only seam rather than publishing new SDK API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow public contract
recommendation.body: Approve the indexed lock as a stable generic SDK capability, with its semantics and compatibility expectations kept explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged transcript-index foundation and authored this explicitly deferred follow-up.
